newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Packaging sees Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Packaging sees Q1 loss.

text.p: Integrated Packaging Assembly Corp said that based on orders to date, it expects to post a first quarter loss of $2 million to $2.5 million on sales of between $5 million and $6 million.
It said results were hurt by lower orders from major customers, compounded by "problems in the quality of certain capital equipment and raw materials."
The company said it expects those trends to impact results through the first half of the year.

"We are continuing our efforts in working with our suppliers to make necessary corrections. Given the fact that the fundamentals of the business have not changed, we remain optimistic about (our) long-term opportunities," Chairman and Chief Executive Victor Batinovich said in a statement.
The company was not immediately to say what the projected loss would work out to on a per share basis.
The consensus estimate among analysts is for a first quarter profit of $0.05 per share, versus $0.02 in the year-ago period, according to First Call.
